release.notes: Android Auto: Extra large tiles are back, pages no longer lose a tile, and guidance posts turn notifications to the car screen. Tesla Model 3/Y motor temperature shows the motor; Tesla Model S/X SoC no longer freezes at 96.4 %. New readings: BMW Gen5 SoC from the cluster, BMW plug-in hybrid ignition, BYD cabin temperature and motor torque, Volvo/Polestar speed, XPeng G6/G9 DC voltage limit, Ford Courier gear, Mazda CX-60 PHEV 13 to 23 values. Toyota hybrid 12 V fixed. MG4 motor speed read removed as a precaution.
